description: This file defines an Android joystick input provider for the Kivy framework, including classes for motion events and joystick management, with integration to pygame for joystick handling.

classes.name: AndroidMotionEvent
classes.description: Represents a motion event for Android joystick input, including position, pressure, and shape.

classes.name: AndroidMotionEventProvider
classes.description: Provides joystick input handling for Android devices, managing joystick creation, updates, and event dispatching.

methods.name: AndroidMotionEvent.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an Android motion event with default profile and touch type.

methods.name: AndroidMotionEvent.depack
methods.description: Unpacks input arguments into motion event properties, setting shape dimensions.

methods.name: AndroidMotionEventProvider.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the joystick provider, setting up joystick list, touches, and window reference.

methods.name: AndroidMotionEventProvider.create_joystick
methods.description: Creates and initializes a joystick object at a given index.

methods.name: AndroidMotionEventProvider.start
methods.description: Initializes joystick subsystem and creates joystick objects.

methods.name: AndroidMotionEventProvider.stop
methods.description: Clears the list of joystick objects.

methods.name: AndroidMotionEventProvider.update
methods.description: Updates joystick states, manages touch events, and dispatches input events.
